cases.question: 1月商品销售额前10名
cases.sql: SELECT p.name,SUM(i.paid_cents) AS sales_cents FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.paid_at>=:start AND o.paid_at<:end AND (:shop='' OR o.shop=:shop) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sales_cents DESC,p.name LIMIT 10
cases.comparison: 结果行及顺序一致，人民币整数分/有效数量；不比较SQL文本
